Short title and commencement 1. (1) This Act may be called the University of Balochistan Act, 1996 and it shall come into force at once.
Definitions 2. In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, University means the University of Balochistan.
Incorporation 3. (1) The University of Balochistan shall be reconstituted at Quetta as a University of the Province.
(2) The University shall consist of the Chancellor, the Vice Chancellor and the members of the Syndicate.
Powers of the University 4. The University shall have the powers to provide for instruction in such branches of learning as it may deem fit.
Jurisdiction 5. The University shall exercise the powers conferred on it within the territorial limits of Balochistan.
Teaching 6. All recognised teaching in the University shall be conducted by the University or by a college affiliated to it.
Officers 7. The officers of the University shall be the Chancellor, the Vice Chancellor, the Registrar and the Treasurer.
Chancellor 8. The Governor of Balochistan shall be the Chancellor of the University and shall preside at convocation.
Pro-Chancellor 9. The Minister for Education shall be the Pro-Chancellor and shall act for the Chancellor when required.
Vice Chancellor 10. The Vice Chancellor shall be the principal executive and academic officer of the University.
Registrar 11. The Registrar shall be a whole-time officer and shall act as Secretary of the Syndicate and the Senate.
Treasurer 12. The Treasurer shall manage the property and the funds of the University and shall present the accounts.
Controller 13. The Controller of Examinations shall conduct the examinations and make the arrangements required for them.
Auditor 14. The accounts of the University shall be audited once a year by an auditor appointed by the Government.
Other officers 15. The University may appoint such other officers as the Syndicate may determine by a written order.
Authorities 16. The Authorities of the University shall be the Senate, the Syndicate and the Academic Council.
Senate 17. The Senate shall be the supreme body of the University and shall have the power to review the acts.
Senate powers 18. The Senate shall consider the annual report and the annual statement of accounts of the University.
Senate quorum note 19. A meeting of the Senate shall be convened by the Chancellor on such date as he may appoint.
Syndicate constitution 20. The Syndicate shall consist of the Vice Chancellor and such other members as this Act names.
Syndicate 21. (1) The Syndicate shall consist of the Vice Chancellor and the members appointed under this Act.
(2) The members of the Syndicate shall hold office for a term of three years.
3. The quorum for a meeting of the Syndicate shall be one-half of the total number of members, a fraction being counted as one.
Power and duties 22. (1) The Syndicate shall be the executive body of the University and shall exercise general supervision over the affairs of the University.
(2) The Syndicate may invest any money belonging to the University in any of the securities described in section 20 of the Trusts Act, 1882 (II of
1882), or in the purchase of immovable property or in such other manner as it may deem fit with the approval of the Chancellor.
Academic Council 23. (1) The Academic Council shall be the academic body of the University and shall have the powers assigned by this Act.
(2) The provisions of the Provident Fund Act, 1925 (Act XIX of
1925) shall apply to such fund as if it were the Government Provident Fund for the purposes of this section.
(3) The University of Balochistan Ordinance, 1970 (Balochistan Ordinance No. I of
1970), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, is hereby repealed and shall not remain in force.
THE FIRST SCHEDULE
(See section 27)
1. Faculties
There shall be a Faculty of Arts and a Faculty of Science. The Board of each Faculty shall consist of the Dean and the Chairmen.
2. Dean
The Dean of each Faculty shall be appointed by the Chancellor on the recommendation of the Syndicate.
4. Boards of Studies
There shall be a Board of Studies for each subject taught in the University.
